Name: Click
Tagline: Serverless agents
Description: Managed Agents API you can use with any model. Send a task with an API call, and Click runs the agent and streams back results. Click gives you the entire agent stack over an API, with no infrastructure to manage. Sessions are created with everything your agent needs - a sandbox, browser, and web search. Agents run on a harness with the latest innovations, like deferred tool discovery to support 1000s of tools, and Code Mode to use tools with scripts.

Name: ClawsGO Science
Tagline: The AI research agent with its own cloud lab
Description: Research, fully automated. ClawsGO Science takes a question to discovery and writes it up as a cited paper. Its cloud lab has 500+ tools and 90+ datasets. Its long-horizon harness runs clusters of Claude and GPT agents for days. The next paradigm for science.

Name: Termy
Tagline: Your coding agent, in the notch
Description: Claude Code and Codex in a terminal that drops down from your MacBook's notch. Live status, approvals from the notch, an office of your agents, a browser for your local server, on-device dictation and checkpoints.

Name: magpie
Tagline: everything you’ve saved, in one visual library
Description: One visual library for everything you save on Instagram, X, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Reddit, Dribbble, Behance, Are.na and the web. Tagged by AI, searchable by meaning and colour, and kept even when the post is gone.

Name: Screen Studio 4.0
Tagline: Glass Loupe, Camera Cutout, Edit by Transcript, and more
Description: The screen recorder for Mac that handles the hard parts: zooms, motion, sound, and framing. Every demo and tutorial comes out polished. What's new in 4.0: - Glass Loupe, a zoom that magnifies one detail - Split screen, also for vertical video - Edit your video like you edit text - Camera cutout: you, without your background - Hide sensitive data and faces automatically - Sharper zooms, ProRes, up to 4x faster exports, and more

Name: Yuzu Sync
Tagline: Mirror, copy or two-way sync folders on your Mac
Description: A small menu-bar app that keeps pairs of folders in sync with a bundled rsync engine. Mirror a project to an SSD, copy photos to a NAS, or sync both ways. Preview changes first, schedule jobs, and remembered disks are matched by UUID so a same-named wrong disk is refused. Every file it replaces or removes is archived for 30 days, never silently deleted. macOS 14+.

Name: Modelpeers
Tagline: Follow AI models and agents like you follow people
Description: Modelpeers is like LinkedIn for AI models and agents. Follow Claude Code, GPT-6, Gemini and 200 others, and see their new versions, price and limit changes, outages and retirements in your feed.

Name: CutCat
Tagline: Skip or mute marked scenes while you watch Netflix
Description: A free Chrome extension that skips or mutes scenes other viewers have marked as sex, nudity, gore, or strong language. You choose which. Works on Netflix in Chrome on a computer. Not affiliated with Netflix.

Name: Precise Edit by Ideogram
Tagline: Precise editing with context window
Topics: Design Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Photo editing
Description: The upgraded Precise Edit supports a context window, so it edits images at any resolution up to 8K at their original pixels and renders small text, logos, and fine detail more sharply.

Name: Hamdori
Tagline: A tiny 3D hamster that lives on your desktop
Description: A 3D golden hamster who lives in a corner of your Mac or Windows desktop. He closes his eyes when you pet him, nibbles seeds while you type and naps when you walk away. Focus timer, toys and a file drawer too. No monitoring permissions, one-time purchase.

Name: Embage
Tagline: Build agent for your customers, run workflows, analyzed.
Description: Build multichannel AI chat and voice agents for your website, Telegram, and beyond. Create specialized sub-agents to orchestrate workflows across your knowledge bases, datastores, and hundreds of third-party tools in real time. Automatically evaluate every interaction, score lead quality, and extract structured data straight from conversation transcripts.

Name: agentmash
Tagline: open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Tech
Description: Agentmash is an open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents, a shared context layer that tells every agent which files a teammate's agent is changing, so the agents talk to each other and work on their own without overwriting anyone's code. You can switch between tasks running on different models, @mention a teammate, your own agent or a teammate's agent like in Slack, and keep skills, chats and automations in sync. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or your own open-source models

Name: Raah.dev
Tagline: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance
Description: Connect payments and conversions with page speed, API latency, errors, and ISP performance in one dashboard. Revenue analytics and real-user observability for humans and AI agents.

Name: Riverside Agents
Tagline: A team of AI agents for video: produce, edit, clip, post
Description: Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial.

Name: Chorin: Ora et Labora
Tagline: Build a real medieval abbey, from 1258 to today
Description: A calm idle game about Kloster Chorin, a real Cistercian abbey near Berlin. Every monk has a name; the seasons and the night change the work, and every chronicle page cites its sources. Free to start, no ads, eight languages, works offline.

Name: ernd
Tagline: The credit card for the AI stack
Description: ernd is a credit card for companies that pay for AI. Card spend at AI vendors earns 4% back, and we're negotiating big partnerships with AI providers for better pricing, faster inference and dedicated GPUs.

Name: BeeBranch
Tagline: The local-first desktop Git client
Description: An open-source alternative to commercial Git clients, built for teams working with GitLab and GitHub: no proprietary cloud, no vendor account, no telemetry and no AI.

Name: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0
Tagline: Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch
Topics: Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Version 4 is a big one. Usage for Claude now tracks ChatGPT accounts too, with your Codex session and weekly limits next to Claude's. See every account at once in three styles (Minimal, Detailed, Chart), put several in the Mac menu bar, and keep them on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and widgets. Alerts tell you before you run out, and the history shows where your week went. You sign in on the official Claude and ChatGPT pages, and your data stays in your own iCloud. Free, with Pro extras.

Name: Fluent 2
Tagline: AI teammates that run locally on your Mac
Description: Introducing AI teammates – saving hours on your routine. They use your apps like you do and keep working while you sleep. Run them on a local model: fully private, no usage limits, and $0 a month. Or pick any cloud model you like.

Name: Veenew
Tagline: Build your corner of the web
Description: One calm space for everything you put on the web. Make a personal website, a blog, a status log or a bookmark collection, or mix them all on your own. Veenew is a simple blogging platform at its core, but flexible enough for regular blogs, microblogs, bookmarks, essays, journals, personal websites, and everything in between.
